user.title: Set up sleep tracking
user.description: Configure sleep tracking for one person. You can add multiple entries to track several people.

data_description.person_name: Display name used in entity and device names (e.g. Philipp).
data_description.in_bed_sensor: Binary sensor that is ON when the person is in bed (e.g. a Withings or pressure-mat sensor).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure sleep tracking
reconfigure.description: Update the person name or change the tracked sensor. The current sleep session state will be reset on reload.

data_description.person_name: Display name used in entity and device names.
data_description.in_bed_sensor: Binary sensor that is ON when the person is in bed.

abort.already_configured: Sleep tracking for this person is already set up.

data_description.interruption_threshold: If the person leaves bed for less than this many minutes, it counts as a brief interruption and the original sleep start time is preserved. Increase this if nightly bathroom trips are splitting your sleep into short sessions.
data_description.min_sleep_duration: A sleep session shorter than this is not recorded in Last Sleep Duration. Prevents accidental short naps from overwriting a full night's sleep.

confirm.title: Tracked sensor not found
confirm.description:
The sensor **{entity_id}** configured for **{name}** does not exist or has not yet reported a state.

If you renamed or removed the sensor, use **Reconfigure** on the integration to select a new one.

Submitting this form dismisses the issue.
